notes: Four distinct interaction episodes are visible: two separate open/close cycles of the same driver-side door, followed by one hood cycle and one rear-hatch cycle. The initial and intervening camera-orbit surveys were not counted.
scene_description: A user circles a stationary blue Toyota Supra in an outdoor parking lot and sequentially manipulates the driver-side door twice, the front hood, and the rear cargo hatch.
